blocks.text: Filipino film “Ria” won the Heart of Eurasia Award at the recently concluded 31st Busan International Film Festival in South Korea. “Ria,” directed by Filipino filmmaker Arvin Belarmino, made its world premiere at BIFF under the Vision Asia section. The 95-minute film is a Philippines-Netherlands-Norway-Saudi Arabia-Japan co-production. READ: Sylvia Sanchez, Nour Hooshmand grace 2026 Busan Int’l Film Festival red carpet It’s producers, actress Sylvia Sanchez and Grace Ann Casimsiman, however, failed to attend the awards night as they had to return to the Philippines immediately following the opening rites.
